summary: Full end-to-end frontend test of BG module WO-first flow on /bank-guarantees. Found and fixed one blocker (WO picker showed 'No work orders found.' due to a wrong endpoint call). After the 1-line fix, every scenario in the review request passed: WO picker + Auto-Linked panel + amount auto-fill(30000), PBG shortfall warning with override note (admin) and disappearance for above-PBG amount, claim<valid_till blocking, Save Draft creating a row, View drawer (WO Summary/Batch linkage/Audit trail), full status workflow draft->submitted->under_verification->active with badge update, Renew creating a new BG referencing the same WO, quick chips + search + clear filters.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not exist (404). Frontend BankGuarantees was calling it. Not a backend bug per se (canonical route is /api/mis/projects) but flagged since BankGuarantees.jsx now uses /mis/projects.

ui_bugs.issue: After creating a Renew BG the ACTIVE KPI card stayed at 0 while the row badge showed Active, and OUTSTANDING/PENDING rendered as -₹5,000 because renewed BG amount is added to total_issued but PBG_required for the underlying WO is not counted twice. Summary math needs review for renewed BGs.
Task mentions 'bg-quick-draft' but no data-testid="bg-quick-draft" chip is rendered (only all/active/expiring_soon/expired/submitted/pending_verification). Non-blocking.

integration_issues.issue: loadRefs used Promise.all with api.get('/projects') which 404s -> whole Promise.all rejects -> catch swallows -> woList stayed empty -> WO picker permanently showed 'No work orders found.' blocking the entire WO-first flow. FIXED by switching to Promise.allSettled and using /mis/projects.

action_items: Review financial summary math when a BG is renewed: currently total_issued double counts (original+renewal) but PBG required does not, producing negative Outstanding/Pending. Decide whether renewed BGs should be excluded from active_bg_value/total_issued or the WO's PBG_required should be treated as satisfied only once.

Consider whether the KPI 'Active' count should reflect effective_status (>30 days from Valid Till when stored status=active) rather than only counting stored status; currently effective badge shows Active in table but Active KPI = 0.
Optionally add a bg-quick-draft chip if drafts should be filterable via quick chips (currently only via search/status filter).
critical_code_review_comments: BankGuarantees.jsx loadRefs used Promise.all + wrong /projects endpoint with a silent catch. Any single reference-data 404 would kill the picker with no user feedback. General pattern to avoid across the codebase: prefer Promise.allSettled when independent reference calls are combined and always surface load errors.
server.py file is ~20k+ lines; consider modularization (already flagged in prior iterations).

success_rate.backend: 100% (curl smoke via wo-context/list/create-status verified indirectly through UI + already-tested by main agent)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 BGs against WO-BG-SEED-01: BG-TEST-<ts> (draft->submitted->under_verification->active), BG-RENEW-<ts> (draft, renewal).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The WO picker depends on GET /api/work-orders + /api/mis/projects + /api/centers. If any of these regresses, the picker will silently show 'No work orders found.' unless the Promise.allSettled fallback (added this iteration) remains. Seeded WO id 6631bff3-9ec2-4662-8766-5c23aac63f0f is still used; two BGs already exist against it after this run.
rca of the issue: Root cause of blocker: BankGuarantees.jsx line 91-95 called api.get('/projects') which returns 404 (canonical route is /api/mis/projects). Because it was wrapped in Promise.all inside a try/catch that swallowed the error, woList was never populated. Fix: switch to Promise.allSettled and use /mis/projects so partial failures don't zero out the WO list. Reproduction pre-fix: login as admin -> /bank-guarantees -> Add BG -> click WO picker -> type anything -> 'No work orders found.'. Post-fix: seed WO WO-BG-SEED-01 appears immediately.
